label: R7 · Your main 1
rationale: Quake's trigger taps a creature or land; you are about to attack with Quake and Aerial Doombot. The opponent has no cards in hand and no open mana, so tapping their lands does nothing; tapping one of their untapped creatures removes a blocker. Tapping your own Quake or Doombot stops your attack, and tapping your untapped Plains loses the white mana for Spy Kit.
